en.bodyHtml:
In this guide you carry out Fix Outlook profile and Autodiscover issues via your mail app (Outlook / Apple Mail / phone). Change only what belongs to Outlook, profile, autodiscover, then verify the result.

Specific to “Fix Outlook profile and Autodiscover issues” — search/context terms: fix outlook profile and autodiscover issues. This belongs with your mail app (Outlook / Apple Mail / phone) and is not a generic hosting blurb.

Preparation

  • Access to your mail app (Outlook / Apple Mail / phone)
  • Topic: Outlook, profile, autodiscover
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Start in your mail app (Outlook / Apple Mail / phone) and only make the change described by “Fix Outlook profile and Autodiscover issues”.
  2. Add or open the account in the client; choose IMAP (recommended) unless you truly need POP.
  3. Enter IMAP/SMTP from the welcome email; username = full address; ports usually 993 and 465/587 with SSL/TLS.
  4. Point the client setting specifically at Outlook / profile as in the title.
  5. Test receive and send; if SMTP fails: check password, port and whether webmail still works.
  6. Check whether Outlook, profile, autodiscover works elsewhere (other network, webmail vs client, staging vs live).
  7. Correlate with the last change; roll back or fix one cause at a time.
  8. Finish “Fix Outlook profile and Autodiscover issues”: confirm Outlook, profile, autodiscover shows the intended result and briefly note what you changed.

Verify

  • Result for Outlook, profile, autodiscover matches “Fix Outlook profile and Autodiscover issues”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside Outlook profile autodiscover
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result
  • “Fix Outlook profile and Autodiscover issues” is complete only if Outlook, profile, autodiscover behaves as expected outside the panel.

Tip: Work in small steps: get Outlook, profile, autodiscover right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if Outlook, profile, autodiscover touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
